I can’t check the live eBay database myself, but I’ll give you a quick pair of “sniff‑tests” you can run in a few seconds on your phone:

| # | Name | Why it feels fresh | Quick eBay test |
|---|------|--------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | **OarCraft Tees** | Evokes the hand‑crafted feel of a rowing club’s kit & the key rowing tool. | Search “OarCraft Tees” → look for an exact match for a brand name or existing shop. |
| 2 | **CrewCanvas Clothing** | “Crew” hints at the rowing crew while “Canvas” nods to the shirt material. | Search “CrewCanvas Clothing” – if nothing pops up, you’re likely free. |
| 3 | **SweepStyle Shirts** | “Sweep” is rowing jargon (sweep rowing), and “Style” positions your shop as fashion‑forward. | Search “SweepStyle Shirts” → no existing store or product listing = safe to use. |

**How to do the quick check:**

1. Open the eBay app.  
2. Tap the search bar at the top.  
3. Enter the name exactly as written (including spaces and “Tees/Clothing/Shirts”).  
4. Inspect the “Shop” tab and any product listings that match.  
5. If you see a shop with that exact name or a product that is identical, you’ll want to pick the next option.

If none show up for any of the three, you’re probably good to register the shop name. Good luck with your rowing‑inspired tee line!
